title: Battle of the Three Islands
intro_text: The enemy has established control over three strategic islands.
These islands form a defensive triangle controlling the central Caribbean.
Your mission: Break through their defensive line and eliminate all enemy ships.
This is a large-scale engagement across open waters.
Use the deep channels to maneuver and divide their forces.
The fate of the entire region hangs in the balance.
Show no mercy - send them all to Davy Jones' locker!
victory_text: GLORIOUS VICTORY! The three islands are liberated!
Your tactical brilliance has shattered the enemy's defensive line.
Enemy ships burn and sink across the entire battle area.
The Caribbean waters are now dominated by your fleet.
Songs will be sung of this legendary naval triumph!
You have proven yourself as one of the greatest admirals of the age.
defeat_text: Crushing defeat. Your fleet has been decimated.
The enemy's coordinated defense was too strong.
Survivors limp back to port with tales of disaster.
The three islands remain under enemy control.
Return when you have mastered naval warfare.

title: The Archipelago Campaign
intro_text: The decisive naval battle has come.
Both fleets have assembled across the vast archipelago.
Rocky islands and treacherous reefs dot the seascape.
This will be your greatest test. Navigate wisely, Commander.
victory_text: VICTORY! The enemy fleet is defeated!
Your strategic mastery has secured total naval supremacy.
defeat_text: The battle was lost at sea.
Even the greatest admirals face defeat.
Learn from this and try again.
